chapter: Hite tours, postwar L.A. and the Central Avenue scene
title: Movie stars at Sebastian's Cotton Club
summary: George Raft, the Talmadges and others visited the biggest nightclub in the world.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: It was A real place to get talent, right? the movie people came down and hired the band for I mean, (inaudible). the Showcase, right?

Oh, it was -- all the movie people of Hollywood came to Sebastian's Cotton Club at one time or the other. The first week that Georgie Raft (PHONETIC) came in town, the first place he came out to was Sebastian's Cotton Club. Texas Guinan (PHONETIC) had sent for him. He was sup-

posed to have been the take-off of the day on Rudolph Valentino, but he was too short. That's what he was brought out for. He was a ballroom dancer and they brought him out. He used to come out there all the time. All the movie stars, the Bennett Sisters, all the Talmadge Sisters, Norma and Constance, they used to come out there. Just about everybody that you could think of that was in big time show business came to Sebastian's Cotton Club because it was the biggest nightclub in the world, sizewise and it had first-class entertainment.

So we practically knew all of the motion picture stars of that day because we knew that as coming-up starlets and coming-up stars from the start to the beginning. We knew when they got a hit and when they didn't, you know? Joan Crawford used to be out, Rosalind Russell. ~~The guy ~~ Clark Gable -- all of the guys that really stood for something in the business.
Back to the Apex. Were there any more entertainers there that you were going to mention?
It's hard to remember many more of -- I was just a teenager at the time and I'm quite a bit more than that now.
You've got an excellent memory, though, Marshal.
